name: City of Reno Parks Volunteer Program
org: City of Reno Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Help with one day tasks or events with Reno Parks and Recreation. Under 16 needs a parent signed release. Ages 16 and older can take regular scheduled tasks.
who_can_apply: Under 16 can do drop-in single-day tasks with a parent-signed release form. 16 and older can do continuous volunteering after a background check. No minimum age is stated.
duration: Drop-in single days, or recurring scheduled tasks
how_to_apply: Drop in: a parent signs the Volunteer Release of Liability Form and you sign a time sheet. Ongoing: send in a Volunteer Application, a Consent and Disclosure form and a Reno PD background form. Get a photo ID card. Call the Volunteer Coordinator at 775-334-2046.
notes: The listed roles on the page are mostly for seniors programs and fund raising. Ask the coordinator what fits a teen.
